gen-fs-chubbo-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu stays clean copy, wide bowls dominating the rhythm, rounds unlatched like hooks on the line. Chubbo does marker-tip bends best; Anek Telugu does those wide bowls.
gen-fs-excon-gf-julius-sans-one: Julius Sans One comes through clean, lowercase nearly matching capitals, curves left unclosed. Excon crowds chalk beside that spaced-out line, so Julius Sans One can run a column without the crowding snagging.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-armata: Chubbo draws marker-tip letters with an unobstructed path around each bend. Armata spaces letters and terminals wide against that marker heading, and that spacing-plus-display contrast is the lock.
gen-fs-excon-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa stays a clean line, thickness unchanging, curves distinct, stubby extenders. Lexend Exa then shares that similar build with crowded Excon, so both keep a sans-serif column moving.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-philosopher: Oswald knits confident rows tight over Philosopher and its daylight curves. And Philosopher keeps a soft thick-thin under that display knit, so the shout and the sans-serif copy share a sheet.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-athiti: Marker-tip display over vinyl-cut copy: Chubbo paired with Athiti below. And Athiti keeps a gap in each s through a column, so the run never clogs under those unobstructed bends.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-pontano-sans: Condensed knit over a wide-open c: Oswald with Pontano Sans. Pontano Sans holds that open c through copy, while Oswald does the tight shout best of all.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-pt-sans: Tightly knit rows of text mark Oswald at a glance. Oswald wants a few huge words, knit tight, while PT Sans holds open c arcs through the copy.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-red-hat-text: Modern knit rows sit over unclamped Red Hat Text from Oswald. Oswald does the condensed shout best, while Red Hat Text holds a technical-pen sans-serif line through copy.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Marker display over near-capital lowercase: Chubbo with Hedvig Letters Sans. The jump from moderate heading height to that near-capital copy is what locks the pair here.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-roboto-flex: Knit shout over a wide c slot: Oswald with Roboto Flex. Roboto Flex holds that wide c slot through copy, while Oswald does the tight display row best.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru stays contemporary copy, lowercase pressing the ascenders, each a left ajar. Marker Chubbo over that near-ascender sans is the quality that holds, no thinning in the line.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-hind-siliguri: Hind Siliguri comes through approachable, rounds gapping like a cracked bangle. Chubbo does marker-tip bends best, while Hind Siliguri holds a flat gray line through copy.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-khula: Khula reads modern, a squat brush-pen belly, mouths held open. Chubbo marker bends sit over that midsection, so Khula can run a column without the heading snagging.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-sansation: Sansation comes through approachable, no ink pooling where curves turn in. If Oswald shrinks, those knit rows smear; if Sansation grows, the unpooled curves still hold.
